note: Expected requirements and conditions, written by hand from the vacancy text before any model run. 'match' is a list of regular expressions tried against a received requirement's text, its alternatives and its quote; any hit finds it. 'level' is the level the text implies ('any' when the wording is ambiguous). 'group' means the demand lists examples or choices and must come back as ONE requirement with alternatives. 'forbidden' are things that must NOT come back as requirements. A condition is 'null' (not stated, must not be reported), a value, or 'either' (a value or null is acceptable).
